caseName: Andrews v. City of San Bernardino
caseNameFull: ANDREWS v. CITY OF SAN BERNARDINO
attorneys: Manuel Ruiz, Jr. for appellant., Waldo Willhoft for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
